name: RakeshRaja Site Doctor
author: Rakesh Raja

sections.description:
RakeshRaja Site Doctor adds a private support page inside wp-admin for WordPress site owners who need help with bugs, errors, updates, or general site issues.

The plugin includes:

  • Basic site health checks for WordPress core, plugins, themes, PHP version, SSL, and debug status.
  • A support request form that lets the site owner contact the developer directly from wp-admin.
  • Optional screenshot upload with the support request.
  • A local log of recent support requests stored in the site database.
  • A floating admin button for quick access to the support page.

This plugin is designed for website owners who want a simple way to review important site status details and request hands-on WordPress help when needed.

No data is sent automatically.

Support request data is sent only when the user explicitly submits the form.

Privacy

This plugin does not send data automatically.

When the support form is used, the submitted details may be emailed to the configured support address so the developer can review the issue and respond.

The plugin stores the last 5 support request summaries locally in the WordPress database for admin reference.

The plugin does not sync support request history to external services unless the user explicitly submits the support form.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open the Site Doctor menu in wp-admin.
  4. Review the site health summary and use the support form if you need help.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin send data automatically?

No. The plugin does not send data automatically. Data is sent only when the user explicitly submits the support request form.

What information is included in a support request?

A support request may include the submitted form details, screenshot if attached, and basic site health information needed to understand the issue.

Does this plugin track active installs or usage?

No. This plugin does not include hidden install tracking or automatic remote reporting.

Does the plugin store support requests?

Yes. The plugin stores the last 5 support request summaries locally in the site database for admin review.

Who is this plugin for?

This plugin is intended for individual WordPress website owners, small business sites, and anyone who wants direct developer help from inside wp-admin.
